acta.cubo.asignacion_no_casa: matches no unit in the scope
acta.cubo.auditor_distinto: the auditor is not the person accountable for the unit
acta.cubo.auditor_responsable: the auditor is the person accountable for the unit

acta.cubo.diferida: deferred, with a reason on record

acta.cubo.esperada_no_casa: matches no incident from this period
acta.cubo.hallazgo_arrastrado: open, carried over from earlier cycles
acta.cubo.incidente_fuera: first known outside the period, not counted by these minutes
acta.cubo.no_consta_remitida: no record that it was sent
acta.cubo.remitida_dentro: recorded as sent within the period
acta.cubo.remitida_fuera: recorded as sent outside the period
acta.cubo.salio_del_alcance: no longer in the scope of this cycle
acta.cubo.sigue_en_alcance: still in the scope of this cycle
acta.cubo.sin_responsable: no record of who is accountable for the unit
acta.descargo.asignacion_que_no_casa: This does NOT say the assignment is wrong: it says this programme does not have that unit in its scope, so its independence has not been examined here.
acta.descargo.empate_de_clasificacion: This does NOT say the classification is a different one: it says two different classifications are on record at the same instant and plazum does not pick one. Whoever signs needs to know that two hands touched this.
acta.descargo.fuera_del_periodo: This does NOT say these incidents do not count: it says they were first known outside the period these minutes cover, so the minutes for their own period count them.
acta.descargo.ilegible: This does NOT say there was anything wrong in those lines: it says they could not be read, so nobody knows what was there and nobody can certify that everything was reviewed.
acta.descargo.independencia: This does NOT say the audit was done badly: it says the person who audited is the same person accountable for what was audited. In a small organisation there may be nobody else, and that is a legitimate answer that has to be written down. What is not acceptable is for it to go unrecorded.
acta.descargo.no_auditado: This does NOT say these obligations are being breached: it says there is no record in this cycle that anyone audited them.
acta.descargo.no_clasificado: This does NOT say these incidents are minor, nor that nobody looked at them: it says there is no classification on record, and without one none of the clocks that depend on the classification can start.
acta.descargo.no_notificado: This does NOT say these notifications were not made: it says the record of these incidents does not show that they were sent.
acta.descargo.no_revisado: This does NOT say these accesses are improper: it says there is no record in this campaign that anyone reviewed them.
acta.descargo.notificacion_que_no_casa: This does NOT say a notification is missing: it says the incident it refers to is not among the incidents these minutes cover.
acta.descargo.remision_fuera_del_periodo: This does NOT say the notification was not made: it says the record shows it was sent outside the period these minutes cover.
acta.descargo.salida_del_alcance: This does NOT say these units were left unmet: it says the scope of this cycle no longer includes them, and that is why they stop being carried over.
acta.descargo.sin_responsable: This does NOT say nobody is accountable for these units: it says there is no record of who is, so the auditor's independence could not be examined.

acta.pantalla.sin_acta.paso: They are composed as soon as at least one of those three sources exists. None of the four sections disappears for being empty, so the minutes will also say what they cannot speak about.
acta.pantalla.sin_acta.que_es: Minutes like these bring together what is already recorded in the audit programme, the access campaign and the incident register, and leave every figure open down to the list it is made of.
acta.pantalla.sin_sesion.por_que: These minutes say who audited what, who deferred and with what reason, who decided each access and who attended. It is a list of who did what inside the organisation, so it is not served to anyone who has not signed in.

acta.pantalla.vacio: This bucket is empty. It appears anyway, with its zero, because a bucket that only shows up when it has something in it is a bucket nobody misses.
acta.pantalla.ver_derivacion: See what this figure is made of
acta.parrafo.arrastra_de: Carried over from cycle %s: whatever that cycle did not get to audit enters this one with its age attached.
acta.parrafo.campana: Campaign %s over sealed snapshot %s (sha256 of the file %s). With that file in hand, anyone can repeat the reading and check that this, and nothing else, is what was reviewed.
acta.parrafo.compone: plazum composes this document from the records the organisation already holds. Every figure carries the list it is made of: there is not one number in these minutes that has to be taken on trust.
acta.parrafo.derivaciones_enteras: Every figure above, opened up. It goes in full and untrimmed: a figure with half a list behind it is a figure that has to be taken on trust again.
acta.parrafo.evidencia_de: These minutes are evidence for the obligations that follow.
acta.parrafo.idioma_del_corpus: Their titles and citations stay in the language of their package and are not translated: the text of a law belongs to its source, and translating it would create a derivative work.
acta.parrafo.no_dice_cumplido: The existence of these minutes does not say the obligations they cover are met. It says there are minutes, with this data and this period. Whether the system works is decided by management, in the last section.
acta.parrafo.no_hay_cuarta: There is no fourth origin. No sentence in this document was drafted by a model: the minutes are composed inside plazum deterministic core, which does not know the AI port, so they come out the same with AI switched off. The ones plazum writes are in its source code, word for word; the data they name comes from the organisation own records.
acta.parrafo.plazum_no_escribe: This part is written by management. plazum does not draft it and cannot draft it, and that is not a technical limitation: a conclusion about whether the system works is precisely what the governing body has to say in its own words, and a plausible paragraph written by a machine in this document would be a forged signature. No management decision is recorded in these minutes yet.
acta.parrafo.primer_ciclo: This is the programme's first cycle, so nothing is carried over. That is not the same as not having looked.
acta.parrafo.sin_campana: No access review campaign is on record. Without one these minutes cannot say how many permissions were looked at, nor over which inventory. An access snapshot has to be uploaded and a campaign opened over it.
acta.parrafo.sin_cubre: There is no record of which obligation these minutes are evidence for. They are composed anyway, but without that nobody can say what they are good for in front of an auditor.
acta.parrafo.sin_incidentes: No incident record is on record. This does NOT say there were none: it says nobody has connected the register, which is a different thing. Without it, these minutes cannot say whether what had to be notified was notified.
acta.parrafo.sin_programa: No internal audit programme is on record. Without one, these minutes cannot say what has been left unaudited nor for how long, which is the question an external auditor always asks. A programme has to be opened with its cycle and its scope.
acta.parrafo.sin_quien_asistio: There is no record of who attended the review. Whoever calls it supplies that: plazum does not know it and does not make it up.
acta.parrafo.verbo_del_periodo: An incident belongs to this period if it was FIRST KNOWN within it, not if it happened within it: what a management review can judge is what the organisation could do from the moment it knew.

aviso.latido.apagado: The heartbeat is off, which is how it ships. Nothing leaves this machine towards us.

aviso.latido.late: The last heartbeat went out fine %d hour ago.|The last heartbeat went out fine %d hours ago.
aviso.latido.no_es_tu_planificador: This is the channel from this machine towards us. Its silence does not mean your deadlines stopped being watched: the verdict above is computed with your clock and without going out to the network.

aviso.planificador.arregla_callado: Run a cycle with plazum latido ciclo and check the timer that launches it. We warn once it goes over %d hours without running.
aviso.planificador.arregla_futuro: Set the machine clock right and wait for the next cycle.
aviso.planificador.arregla_nunca: Schedule plazum latido ciclo every hour, in cron or in a systemd timer. There is an example in docs/latido.md.
aviso.planificador.arregla_sin_instante: Tell us about it, this should not happen.
aviso.planificador.callado: Your scheduler has not run for %d hour. While it stays stopped, deadlines pass with nobody watching them.|Your scheduler has not run for %d hours. While it stays stopped, deadlines pass with nobody watching them.
aviso.planificador.futuro: The last scheduler mark is in the future, so we cannot tell you whether it is alive. It is usually the machine clock, not plazum.
aviso.planificador.late: The scheduler is alive. Its last run finished %d hour ago.|The scheduler is alive. Its last run finished %d hours ago.
aviso.planificador.nunca: The scheduler has not run a single cycle yet. If you have just installed plazum that is normal, if it has been installed for days it is not.
aviso.planificador.sin_instante: We do not know which instant to judge from, so we cannot tell you whether the scheduler is alive. That is our fault, not yours.

uar.cierre.que_es: Closing means signing that everything has been reviewed. If anything is unreviewed or a line is unexcused, plazum will not let you close and says exactly what is missing.
uar.duplicadas: %d row of the file repeated an access already listed and is not reviewed twice.|%d rows of the file repeated an access already listed and are not reviewed twice.

uar.excusar.deja_rastro: An excuse is recorded with your name and your reason, and it appears in the report. It is not a way to make it go away, it is a way to answer for it.
uar.excusar.hasta: To line (leave empty for a single one)
uar.excusar.no_es_numero: The field «%s» is not a line number. It is not taken as zero: an excuse for line zero excuses nothing and would stay in the record forever.
uar.identidad.reproducible: With that file in hand, anyone can repeat the reading and check that this, and nothing else, is what was reviewed.
uar.ilegibles.bloquean: They block closing. Nobody knows what was there, so completeness cannot be certified. Fix it in the file, or excuse it in writing below.
